hard_gates.finding: SPA deep links return HTTP 200 and load the canonical API projection.
320px and 375px measurements report no horizontal overflow or horizontal scroll movement.
Primary navigation, main landmark, h1 then h2 hierarchy, labels, and native details controls appear in ARIA snapshots.
First keyboard focus reaches Skip to run content with a 3px visible outline.
Browser console reports zero errors or warnings and observed API requests return 200.
API tests bind exact Strategy input into a digest-bound proposal and Run Bundle; the old fixed-workload form defect is absent.

soft_flags.finding: Two recovery items make the 375px active-run page 1954px tall; this is acceptable for the fixture but should be retested with larger command sets.
Command digests wrap without overflow but remain technical; a future copy affordance could reduce scanning cost.

screenshot_review.finding: State, cause, next action, and authority boundary lead the run page; recovery follows graph status.
Strategy authoring presents saved templates and exact JSON as two inputs to the same proposal review.

human_study.claim: A target operator understands the difference between structural completion and result acceptance.
A target operator can author a useful strategy without guidance or examples.

not_automatable.claim: The visual direction creates appropriate trust for every orchestration domain.
